page.overview:
Who is Pansy Baggins?

Pansy Baggins (b. TA 2812 or SR 1212) was the daughter of Balbo Baggins and Berylla Boffin, and the great-aunt of Bilbo Baggins.

She was the second oldest of the four other children of Balbo and Berylla, the others being Mungo (the oldest), Ponto, Largo, and Lily (the youngest). She married Fastolph Bolger but they had no children.
